# NESRA Home (نسرة هوم)

> NESRA Home is an Egyptian women's homewear brand based in Cairo. It designs house dresses (فساتين بيت), pajama sets (بيجامات حريمي) and house kaftans (قفاطين بيت) in breathable fabrics with a relaxed, flowing cut, in sizes S to 5XL (plus sizes included). Orders are placed online at https://darnesra.com or on WhatsApp +20 129 002 8408. Payment is cash on delivery with no deposit; delivery is within Cairo for 80 EGP, and pieces are made to order and delivered within 20 days of order confirmation. Size exchanges within 3 days of delivery if the piece is unused.

- Website: https://darnesra.com
- WhatsApp: +201290028408
- Email: info@darnesra.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/darnesra
- TikTok: @nesrahome
- Language: Arabic (Egyptian)
- Service area: Cairo, Egypt (Giza and other governorates not yet)

## Ordering and policies

- Payment: cash on delivery (الدفع كاش عند الاستلام), no prepayment.
- Delivery: Cairo only, 80 EGP; made to order, delivered within 20 days of confirmation.
- Exchanges: size exchange within 3 days of delivery if the item is in original condition.
- Size guide: every product page lists bust and length in cm for each size.
